title: Will YouTube Ever Run Out Of Video IDs?
summary: Tom Scott explains YouTube's 11-character video IDs, which are base-64 encoded 64-bit numbers, and whether YouTube could ever run out of them. It covers counting systems and base 64 briefly.
why: HN links it whenever IDs, base64 or random identifier space come up, as a short and pleasant explainer.
